notes: Latency model: the vector divider retires 4 quotient bits per cycle on every element width and the slowest lane dominates. lat = 16.99 when the quotient is 0, 29 when it fits in four bits, otherwise 29 + 4 * floor(bits(quotient)/4); for h elements the quotient is at most 16 bits, so the maximum is 41.  Measured with a calibrated reset chain (closure 8 cycles) on the maximum-latency operand pair; 1000-unroll slope method.
